groundRule: a ground tile is exactly ppt x ppt px (the scene's depth is stretched by 1/sin(35)); heights show at ppt*cos(35) px per tile

groundRect.note: the image's ground area in tiles

door-boss.anchorNote: the point of the image that sits on the anchor spot (default: bottom-centre of the footprint)
door-boss.note: Boss door (the Floor Keeper's door) for the 'D' slot of the room before the boss: frame 0 closed, frame 1 open (the doors slide apart behind the posts, the doorway glows warm). 160 px wide: the 1-tile opening in the middle and the stone frame overlapping half a wall tile on each side (draw it over those wall tiles). anchorPx = bottom-centre of the door cell. Add door-boss-glow on top while it's closed and the room is being fought

groundRect.note: the image's ground area in tiles

door-boss-glow.anchorNote: the point of the image that sits on the anchor spot (default: bottom-centre of the footprint)
door-boss-glow.note: The boss door's glow loop (8 frames at 8 fps = 1 s): a gold halo swells around the crown medallion and light breathes along the gold frame. Same size and anchor as door-boss; draw it on top of door-boss frame 0 while the door is closed and the room is being fought. Straight alpha, see-through

groundRect.note: the image's ground area in tiles

icon-boss.anchorNote: the point of the image that sits on the anchor spot (default: bottom-centre of the footprint)
icon-boss.note: the boss door's crown icon on its round medallion, on its own (like icon-battle: for labels, the floor map or buttons)
